title: Some remarks on structured Keyfitz-Kranzer systems
summary: Several applications for systems of conservation laws of the form $U_t + (Φ(U) U)_x =0$, $U: R_t\times R_x\rightarrow R^n$ , $n\geq 2$, with $Φ(U) = φ(r, Θ): R^n\rightarrow R$, $r = |U|$, and $Θ= U/|U|\in S^{n-1}$, are obtained by imposing structural conditions to provide a classification framework for solutions dependent on the form of $φ(U)$. By prescribing the evolution of a particular eigenvalue, we can categorize classes of such functions, $φ$, for which this evolution is met, into depending on either a scalar field $z=rK(Θ)$, where $K: S^{n-1}\rightarrow R$, or on the vector field $Θ$,…
